snippet.title: Kejora - Official New Release Date Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: When Kejora realizes that her peaceful village has been reliving the same day over and over, she and her friends seek out to try and uncover the origin of the mysterious time loop cursed on her village. Get another look at Kejora in this latest trailer for the upcoming puzzle game. Kejora will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation on January 8, 2026.
